title: Eclipse Theia workspace prompts and filenames can redirect the AI chat agent
summary: Theia before 1.71.0 automatically loaded workspace prompt templates and included filenames in prompt context without separating them from instructions. Malicious repositories could redirect the agent; combined with other untrusted-workspace features, this enabled data exfiltration or command execution.

severity.rationale: Opening and analyzing a malicious repository can redirect the coding agent into data exposure or command execution chains. The workspace and AI chat prerequisites make this a high-priority developer exposure.

exposure: Requires malicious workspace .prompts/*.prompttemplate files or adversarial file or directory names, plus AI chat processing. Exfiltration and execution depend on other AI chat features available in untrusted workspaces.

params.instructions: Check the Theia version against 1.71.0, including the version embedded by any downstream IDE.

remediation.details: Update Theia to 1.71.0 or a later patched release.
remediation.risk: Medium. Restart affected sessions and validate dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the running Theia build is patched before using AI chat on untrusted workspaces.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
